properties.description: PaloAltoCortexXDR_High_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.1.0
A new incident was created in the Cortex XDR portal with a severity "High". Click on the events for incident details.
properties.query:
PaloAltoCortexXDR_Incidents
| where Severity contains "high"
| where Status !contains "resolved_auto"
// the below line filters for incidents that has at least one user or one host in it. Comment the below line if you want to generated incidents that have 0 user or 0 host as well
| where HostCount > 0 or UserCount > 0
| extend Hosts_s = tostring(Hosts), Users_s = tostring(Users)
| project TimeGenerated, IncidentId, Status, Severity, IncidentSources, Description, XdrUrl, Hosts_s, Users_s, AlertCategories, HostCount, UserCount, AlertCount, CreationTime, ModificationTime

let CcpIncidents = view () {
    PaloAltoCortexXDR_Incidents_CL

        Starred                    = tobool(column_ifexists("Starred", bool(null))),

        Users                      = todynamic(column_ifexists("Users", dynamic(null))),

instructionSteps.title: Configuration steps for the Palo Alto Cortex XDR API
instructionSteps.description: Follow the instructions below to obtain your API URL and API Token.

parameters.content: For more information, see the [Cortex XDR API guide](https://cortex-docs.paloaltonetworks.com/xdr-3-api/get-started-with-cortex-xdr-apis).

#### 1. Retrieve API URL
Log in to your Cortex XDR console. Navigate to **Settings > Configurations > Integrations > API Keys** and select **Copy API URL**.

#### 2. Retrieve API Token
On the **API Keys** page, select **New Key**, choose **Standard**, and select **Generate**. Copy the API Token and its API Key ID. Give the key read access to incidents, alerts, endpoints and audits.

**Standard keys only:** Advanced keys are not supported.

instructionSteps.title: Configuration steps for the Palo Alto Cortex XDR API
instructionSteps.description: Follow the instructions below to obtain your API URL and API Token.

parameters.content: For more information, see the [Cortex XDR API guide](https://cortex-docs.paloaltonetworks.com/xdr-3-api/get-started-with-cortex-xdr-apis).

#### 1. Retrieve API URL
Log in to your Cortex XDR console. Navigate to **Settings > Configurations > Integrations > API Keys** and select **Copy API URL**.

#### 2. Retrieve API Token
On the **API Keys** page, select **New Key**, choose **Standard**, and select **Generate**. Copy the API Token and its API Key ID. Give the key read access to incidents, alerts, endpoints and audits.

**Standard keys only:** Advanced keys are not supported.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Palo Alto Cortex XDR data connector allows ingesting logs from the Palo Alto Cortex XDR API into Microsoft Sentinel. The data connector is built on Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Platform. It uses the Palo Alto Cortex XDR API to fetch agents, alerts, incidents, management and endpoint logs and it supports DCR-based ingestion time transformations that parses the received security data into a custom table, thus resulting in better performance.

Data Connectors: 1, Parsers: 1, Analytic Rules: 3
